name: Notification stack
what: Notification cards arrive one after another - each slides in from the side and lands with a small buzz; new ones go under the others or on top, pushing them down. Light cards or dark glass with a lock-screen clock.

learned_from.what: the cards sliding in faded from the right and stacking
the dark pill with an icon
a banner on a lock screen

motion: a card every 26 f: slides in 16 f (power3.out) from 110 px, a 5 f buzz; on top: the others move down 12 f (S-curve)
